visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless top and a purple flower lei, stands outdoors in daylight. She smiles broadly, looking directly at the camera while waving her hand. The background shows rows of blue and white chairs on a green lawn with palm trees. (2) The scene transitions to a nighttime performance stage. Red glowing text overlays appear on screen against a backdrop of palm trees and a dark sky. (3) Multiple male performers in traditional loincloths are seen on a stage decorated with floral murals. They carry flaming torches and move with high energy. (4) Close-up shots of a male performer spinning a flaming staff rapidly, creating circles of fire. A small circular inset shows the female host reacting with an open-mouthed expression of awe. (5) Three young boys, also in traditional attire and face paint, perform a synchronized fire dance. They stack on top of each other to form a pyramid while holding flaming staffs. (6) A solo male performer spins two flaming staffs simultaneously in a high-speed motion. The lighting is dominated by the orange glow of the fire against the dark night. (7) A group of performers continues the fire dance on the stage as the camera pans slightly. Digital overlays with social media handles and 'like/follow' prompts appear at the bottom.
